name: m5-unreachable-ab
description: Timing A/B of retronym/scala#200 against its base, with an A/A as the noise floor: `aa` is a second build of the same commit as `base`. The expected effect is well under 1%, and this machine has endpoint-security noise the load gate cannot see, so a difference counts only if it clearly exceeds `aa` vs `base`.

Both builds with the release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); corpora compiled plainly, where unreachable-code removal is the only optimiser pass on. Patched JDK 26 (`jdk26-integration-branch-e9e67e`), 8G heap. scala: single-shot 4+4 ops; scalap: 20+20 x 2 s. Builds alternate fork by fork over 5 rounds.

variantDescriptions.aa: the same commit as `base`, for the noise floor
variantDescriptions.pr: [retronym/scala#200](https://github.com/retronym/scala/pull/200): don't emit code codegen can tell is unreached, and skip unreachable-code analysis for methods with nothing to remove
